title: A licensee may not provide a practitioner with blank prescription forms that refer to a pharmacist or pharmacy
rule_summary: Under 247 CMR 9.01(14), a licensee may not provide any practitioner with blank prescription forms which refer to any pharmacist or pharmacy.
exam_relevance: Tests the elements of 247 CMR 9.01(14): providing, to any practitioner, blank prescription forms which refer to any pharmacist or pharmacy.

authority.name: Massachusetts Board of Registration in Pharmacy regulations

common_confusions: 247 CMR 9.01(11) is a separate paragraph addressed to remuneration or anything of value in return for referrals or the generation of business.
verification_notes: Read on 2026-09-16 in the Board of Registration in Pharmacy's publication of 247 CMR 9.00 on mass.gov (PDF, Mass. Register #1536, 12/6/2024).
